title: Internal: Retention Offers - Minimum Account Age
content:
## Eligibility for Retention Offers

- Retention offers of any kind (annual fee waivers, bonus points, statement credits) are only available on credit card accounts that have been open for at least 180 days.
- Calculate the account age from the account open date.

## Accounts Open Fewer Than 180 Days

- Do not make a retention offer.
- Log the customer's closure reason and, if the account meets the closure requirements, proceed with the closure once the customer confirms.
